create_cluster_hdbscan: create a HDBSCAN clustering model on digit data and compute v_measure_score against true labels
encode_target_categorical: encode high-cardinality categorical features using TargetEncoder with a shrunk estimate of target means
build_tree_classifier_missing: build a DecisionTreeClassifier that handles missing values in features via surrogate split evaluation
plot_validation_curve: plot a validation curve for LogisticRegression across a range of C parameter values
run_gamma_gradient_boosting: run HistGradientBoostingRegressor with gamma loss on right-skewed positive targets using cross_val_score
